title: fix(cli): os dev compiles the config before it boots, so served connector metadata matches dispatch
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8JqqR7yTqyhz4Qfad5wYWK)_

Fixes #26130

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong

A host config's `os dev` boot holds two copies of one stack. The config module, evaluated in the `serve` child, feeds the AppPlugin wrap; provider-bound connectors are materialized from that registry copy, so it is what dispatch calls. The compiled `dist/objectstack.json` feeds the dev artifact door, and its copy is what `/api/v1/meta/connector/NAME` serves. `examples/app-showcase` builds its connectors' `baseUrl` from `OS_PORT` at module evaluation, and `os dev` booted whatever artifact was already on disk, so the two copies disagreed whenever the artifact had been built in another environment.

Measured on `examples/app-showcase` at this branch's base (`c7aa9cde`), `OS_PORT=41302`, the artifact compiled with no `OS_PORT` (`baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:3000`), nothing listening on 3000. "dispatch" is `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_declarative_connector_ping/trigger`, whose one node calls `showcase_status_api.request` for `GET /api/v1/health`.

| boot | `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/showcase_status_api` → `providerConfig.baseUrl` | dispatch |
|---|---|---|
| `os dev --no-compile` (= a bare `os dev` before this PR) | `http://127.0.0.1:3000` | 200, `status: ok` (reached 41302) |
| `os dev` (this PR) | `http://127.0.0.1:41302` | 200, `status: ok` |
| `os start` (production, config joins the boot) | `http://127.0.0.1:41302` | 200, `status: ok` |
| `os serve objectstack.config.ts` (production) | `http://127.0.0.1:41302` | 200, `status: ok` |
| `os serve --dev objectstack.config.ts` | `http://127.0.0.1:3000` | 200, `status: ok` (reached 41302) |

`os start` and production `os serve` compose no artifact door, so they serve the module's copy and already agree; they are unchanged. `os serve --dev` has the same two copies; see Acceptance notes.

## The fix

Of the two routes the order named, this takes (b): the dev boot compiles instead of reading the artifact as found. `--compile` is now on by default, so `os dev` compiles `objectstack.config.ts` into the artifact it serves, in its own environment, before the `serve` child starts. Both copies are then one evaluation's answer, and nothing restates which variables a config reads or in what order (no second copy of the port/URL precedence). The watch loop's recompiles already ran in that environment, so the two stay one answer for the session.

Route (a), re-resolving env-derived connector config at an artifact boot, has nothing to re-resolve from: the artifact holds the value, not the expression that produced it. Carrying the expression would need a new `packages/spec` form for env-derived values, which the rulings put out of reach, so it is not proposed.

- `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`: the decision is one exported function, `devCompilesAtBoot`. A pinned artifact (`--artifact`, `OS_ARTIFACT_URL`, a remote `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH`) is never rebuilt. `--no-compile` keeps the old shortcut and the startup staleness warning. A missing artifact is still compiled. With no config, an existing artifact boots as before.
- Cost: one compile per dev start. Measured on the showcase: 6.5 s for `os compile` (737 KB artifact).
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: the `--compile` row now says default on and names `--no-compile`. This file is outside the claim's file surface, but the docs row would be false without it.
- `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`: one census entry for the new test, which spawns the built entry (see Gates).
- `examples/app-showcase/src/system/self-url.ts`: header comment only. Its `os dev` claim ("follows the live environment") is now true for the served metadata too, and it names the `--no-compile` exception.

## Tests

At head `ac8dadabc` (the three dev test files rerun there: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 15 passed (15)`; the unit tier and typecheck ran at `7f3d5bee`, whose only difference from the head is the census line in `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`):

- New `packages/cli/test/dev-connector-env-parity.integration.test.ts` (integration tier, built entry). It uses a minimal host config with one provider-bound connector whose `baseUrl` is built from `OS_PORT` the way `self-url.ts` builds it, and a host plugin whose provider factory records the `providerConfig` it was handed. A prebuilt artifact carries `:3000`. One `os dev` boot with `OS_PORT=41302` checks that the served `baseUrl` and the materialized one both read `http://127.0.0.1:41302`. Result: `Tests 2 passed (2)`.
- New `packages/cli/test/dev-compile-at-boot.pin.test.ts` (unit tier) checks oclif's parse plus `devCompilesAtBoot` for each case: bare, `--no-compile`, pinned, missing artifact, no config. It passed with `dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: `Tests 1 failed | 4858 passed`. The one failure was `boot-preparation-parity.test.ts`, which timed out at 5934 ms against its 5000 ms limit while the gate sweep shared the box. Run alone it answered `Tests 37 passed (37)`. It reads `serve.ts`, which this PR does not touch.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- Ablation, run once: `devCompilesAtBoot`'s default arm was mutated to `false` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the CLI was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `packages/cli/dist/commands/dev.js`. The integration test then failed with `expected 'http://127.0.0.1:3000' to be 'http://127.0.0.1:41302'` on the served leg, while the materialized leg stayed green, which is the card's defect exactly. The source was restored (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), the CLI rebuilt, and the preflight `--absent` check passed.

## Gates

Local subset, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `ac8dadabc`: 120 families derived. `--ran` reconciliation: 118 run with exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.

- NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite not met (exit 3), because both read a full-repo build that this container did not make: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. CI runs both.
- `pnpm check:cli-test-child-env` went red on the first sweep because its census pins the exact set of test files that spawn the built `bin/run.js`, and the new integration test joins that set. The census in `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` now names the file with a one-line reason, the same form as the other members. The gate is green, and its self-test passed all 152 cases. The script's one other `git grep` hit is a comment in `serve-node-env-production-default.e2e.test.ts`, which no vitest project selects.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876…` (its positive control), it passed 48 cases.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched source files: exit 0. Neither touched package has a `lint` script.
- Every family CI runs is cited from this PR's check-runs in the report, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- **`os serve --dev objectstack.config.ts` has the same disagreement** (row 5 above): it composes the dev artifact door and does not compile. This PR does not widen to it, per the ruling. It is reported to the seat.
- **`os dev -p 41302` with no `OS_PORT` in the environment**: `os dev` forwards the port to `serve` as `--port` and exports no `OS_PORT`, so the showcase's config resolves `:3000` in both copies. They agree, but dispatch fails with `connector_action(showcase_status_api.request) failed: fetch failed` (measured, `FLOW_FAILED` 400). `self-url.ts` says it follows "the same names, in the same order, that the CLI itself reads to choose the listen port", and the flag is not one of them. This is #7538's symptom on the flag path, not this card. It is reported to the seat.
- `os dev` now rewrites `dist/objectstack.json` at every start. An `os start` that later boots that file alone serves the values of the last dev boot's environment. That was already true after any watch recompile, and `self-url.ts` already says to set the environment for the build.

#26088 remains open; this PR does not address it.
